title: From Individual-Based Stochastic Epidemics to Heterogeneous SIR Equations
summary: We develop a stochastic framework for a broad class of heterogeneous SIR epidemic models. In the finite-population construction, each initially susceptible individual is assigned a fixed nonnegative susceptibility, and infection occurs when the accumulated population-level infection pressure exceeds an individual random threshold. Infectious periods are independent and exponentially distributed with a common recovery rate.
